responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for the Renesas/NEC V850 family, covering the machine-specific code generation, ABI, and target-option support needed to lower generic GCC RTL and declarations into V850 assembly and object layout. Its core implementation and configuration files define target hooks, calling conventions, register and frame handling, section selection, symbolic and small-data-area placement, assembler/linker specs, and target-visible options such as CPU variants, ABI choices, and SDA/TDA/ZDA size policies. The machine description, predicates, constraints, and custom condition-code modes describe the V850 instruction set, operand legality, addressing forms, prologue/epilogue and interrupt sequences, and scheduling/recognition details that drive instruction selection and emission. The module also includes C-family target glue for Green Hills compatible pragmas and data-area/section control, plus subtarget support such as RTEMS configuration, making this directory the distinguishing home of V850-specific instruction semantics, memory-model handling, and runtime code-generation policy within GCC.
